text:
ana: seeing rising GPU mem-pressure and transient packet loss in east1d (zone d). p95 latency for gen requests spiked 4x at 12:02 UTC. some pods OOMing and kubelet show EvictionPressure.

sam: confirmed. metrics: gpu_free_memory per-node dropping below 500MB on a subset. network errors also trending on node nic index 3.

mike: sounds like we should do a staged escape (cordon -> drain low-priority -> funnel traffic). prefer drain order: spot -> burst-reserve -> reserved. keep warm pools in other zones.

ana: agree. plan proposal: 1) cordon affected nodes in east1d 2) shift 30% traffic to west1 and usw2 via route weight changes 3) drain low-priority pods (non-prod + batch) first 4) if pressure continues, escalate to staged tenant offload. timeline 30m for step1-3.

sam: add cost note: spinning on-demand GPUs in west1 for 30-60m ~ estimated $1.2k. can we prefer model-variant fallback to int8 quantized to reduce token cost and memory?

mike: yes — we've validated q4-int8 variant for most routes. ops: can we set smart-routing to prefer quantized variants in east1d as a local fallback?

opsbot: autoscaler triggered launch of 4 reserved fallback GPU instances in usw2 at 12:05 UTC (action id: ASG-2143).

jia: running drain commands now for nodes:```\nkubectl cordon gnode-east1d-3\nkubectl drain gnode-east1d-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60\n```

ana: do not drain all nodes at once. use stagger of 2 nodes at a time, wait 4m between batches. preserve one GPU node per rack for cache-warm.

sam: started route53 weighted update: east1d -> 70, west1 -> 20, usw2 -> 10. applying now.

mike: verify KV cache warming on west1/warm-pool: we need prefix prefetch for common convo prefixes. run cache-warm job with subset of traffic.

jia: kicked off cache-warm job (task id: warm-2143001). logs: "warming 120 prefixes -> 8 warm nodes ready".

ana: monitoring: p95 latency down from 4x to 1.6x after first wave of drains and route shift. memory pressure reduced slightly.

sam: tenant-impact: ~3% requests saw increased latency, no error-rate increase yet. prod-critical tenants pinned to reserved in other zones unaffected.

mike: if pressure persists beyond 45m, prepare for cross-zone pod eviction for non-critical tenants and enable quantized fallback for chat route. ops: need approval to start evicting non-critical.

opsbot: alert: node gnode-east1d-7 reported NIC retransmits > 5% (12:18 UTC).

jia: draining next pair: gnode-east1d-5/6. running now.

ana: status check at 12:25 UTC: scheduled drains on track. next: run health-check for replica counts and redis shard mapping after each pair. please ack when validated.

mike: ack, I'll validate replica counts and start a quick reroute test for canary traffic.

sam: cost mitigation suggestion: after steady state, revert non-prod to spot in west1 and turn off on-demand fallback; net cost reduction ~40% over 2h.

jia: drains finished for nodes 3,5,6. replica counts: ok. redis shard rebuild in progress for shard-7 -> expected 5m.

ana: good. once redis rebuild done and p95 < 1.2x baseline, we'll stop route weight adjustments and uncordon any healthy nodes. keep quantized fallback enabled for 1h.

mike: deploying small traffic canary back to east1d (5% of gen requests) to validate stability.

sam: thumbs up :thumbsup:. opsbot: keep this thread updated on autoscaler and alerts.

opsbot: autoscaler: ASG-2143 scale-in prevented due to active drains. next check in 10m.

jia: redis shard rebuild completed at 12:40 UTC. p95 latency stable at 1.1x baseline.

ana: teardown checklist: 1) confirm no node NIC errors 2) uncordon healthy nodes 3) revert route53 weights to normal 4) disable temporary quantized-only fallback 5) document costs and run postmortem. owners: uncordon=jia, route-revert=sam, fallback-disable=mike, postmortem=ana.

mike: noted. final note: remind SRE to adjust warm-pool target for east1d to 2 nodes to reduce fragility.

sam: wrapping up. will file incident note and cost estimate. thanks everyone. :pray:
